mapper.insert: insert into ai_chat_session(user_id, title, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at) values (#{userId}, #{title}, now(), now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, title, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at from ai_chat_session where user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0 order by last_message_at desc, id desc
